notes_for_editor: Build date conflict left open: register says 1948 (L-4 cab); firelookout.com says L-4 cab 1936; Rex's page says a lookout house c.1936 and a 14x14 L-4 ground house in 1948. Register photos captioned 1942 suggest a lookout stood before 1948, but that is an inference, and the story says so. Forest conflict: register and firelookout.com say Umpqua National Forest; Rex's page heading says Willamette National Forest. Destruction date: Rex's page quotes a 9-17-68 note; firelookout.com says 1968; register says gone by 1969. Do not confuse with Dome Rock Lookout Site - WNF near Detroit (Marion County, US 588 in the FFLA list), which is a different site. Record coordinates (43.45151, -122.4045) differ from the FFLA list (43.45173, -122.40248) by roughly 160 m; no correction proposed. No source describes what remains on the summit today; the 1953 route description is historical and no current access level is recorded, so the access field was left out.
